mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with eslicarbazepine may increase serotonergic activity and lower seizure threshold, while eslicarbazepine may induce metabolism of certain substrates and potentially affect MAOI levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution under specialist supervision; if necessary, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome and seizure control; consider alternative anticonvulsants with fewer MAOI interactions.
